rows: Measured with `bench:service` (n=5, the same method as the earlier slices; `docs/audits/benchmarks/rca-post-serde.json`, compared with `rca-post-std.json`): binary 21.85 MB (21.61 MB before), cold start 34.5 ms (33.8 ms), idle RSS 10.37 MB (10.26 MB), `GET /health` p50 0.38 ms, chat turn p50 104.8 ms (105.0), run once 107.5 ms (107.4), ws request 0.087 ms (0.088), voice transcribe 2.2 ms (2.0). Every route is within noise of the previous slice; the validation was never on a hot path.
